title: Job Openings at Adenola and Sons Trading Enterprises
content:
Adenola and Sons Trading Enterprises is an establishment that deals with distribution and re-distribution of superior goods and services of FMCG.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Account Officer

Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Responsible for selling Volume, Distribution, Pricing, Shelving and Merchandising to all stores in coverage.
	Responsible for ensuring quality execution of sales fundamentals in stores. Included are: Distribution of all SKUs in each key channel; retail pricing objective met. Shelving and Merchandising objective met. DTR selling Criteria met, or exceeded.
	Responsible for identifying and developing new and potential customers to ensure a minimum of 250 productive customers per week. This includes extensive work to convert unproductive customers in current route plan and identify new ones.
	Selling at retail pricing in line with company objectives.
	Ensuring store prices are in line with company objectives.
	Responsible for reporting to manager. This includes: Competitive information, Sales fundamental, Daily Coverage Reports.
	Driving of the vehicle.
	Preventive maintenance of the vehicle.


Application Closing Date: 10th August, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note


	For more enquiries, WhatsApp 09036772122.
	Applicants must reside in Ibadan or Oluyole environs.


 

 

2.) Delivery Driver

Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities


	Driving of the vehicle
	Preventive maintenance of the vehicle
	Ensuring goods are delivered to customers on time.


Application Closing Date: 10th August, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note


	For more enquiries, WhatsApp 09036772122.
	You must be able to drive a manual transition vehicle with a valide drivers license.
	You must live within Ibadan (Oluyole, Ringroad, Challenge, Mokola, Elebu, Apata) and its environs.


 

3.) Van Sales Representative

Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities


	Responsible for selling Volume, Distribution, Pricing, Shelving and Merchandising to all stores in coverage.
	Responsible for ensuring quality execution of sales fundamentals in stores. Included are: Distribution of all SKUs in each key channel; retail pricing objective met. Shelving and Merchandising objective met. DTR selling Criteria met, or exceeded.
	Responsible for identifying and developing new and potential customers to ensure a minimum of 250 productive customers per week. This includes extensive work to convert unproductive customers in current route plan and identify new ones.
	Selling at retail pricing in line with company objectives.
	Ensuring store prices are in line with company objectives.
	Responsible for reporting to manager. This includes: Competitive information, Sales fundamental, Daily Coverage Reports.
	Driving of the vehicle
	Preventive maintenance of the vehicle


Requirements


	You must be able to drive a manual transition vehicle with a valide drivers license.
	You must live within Ibadan (Oluyole, Ringroad, Challenge, Mokola, Elebu, Apata) ant its environs.


Remuneration
N100,000 monthly.

Application Closing Date: 11th August, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note


	For more enquiries, WhatsApp 09036772122.
	You must be able to drive a manual transition vehicle with a valid drivers license.
	You must live within Ibadan (Oluyole, Ringroad, Challenge, Mokola, Elebu, Apata) and its environs.

Entry Level Sales / Customer Service Officer Job at Trav4College




        
    

        
        Trav4College is an educational travel technology platform for African students that simplifies the college application process. The company is disrupting the college travel market in Africa with cutting-edge technology.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Entry Level Sales / Customer Service Officer

Job Locations: Abuja (FCT), Edo, and Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	Respond promptly to clients' inquiries and concerns via phone, email, or in person.
	Counsel students and send them abroad for higher studies.
	Coordinate with students & universities abroad.
	Identify skills, interests & career goals of the prospective students.
	Organizing marketing activities for promoting the company.
	Attending university training & workshops.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in English, International Relations, or a related field.
	1+ years of experience in international student recruitment or admissions.
	Knowledge of global education systems and visa processes.
	Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
	Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Human Resources Manager Job at Flour Mills of Nigeria Plc




        
    

        
        Flour Mills of Nigeria Plc has been a part of the lives of Nigerians at home and abroad. Our global vision is to be a leading foods company in Africa providing high quality and affordable products in the most convenient ways to consumers through world class brands like Golden Penny Flour, Golden Penny Semovita, Goldenvita, Golden Pasta and Golden Noodles. The Company's flagship brand, Golden Penny, remains one of the best known and the preferred brands amongst bakers, confectioneries and consumers in Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Human Resources Manager

Job Location: Sunti, Niger 

Purpose
     

            
    




	To recruit, manage and retain competent Human Capital for the organization in the most cost-effective manner ensuring quality service delivery.


The Job


	Manage Recruitment and Selection processes to ensure highest qualified candidates are sourced and retained.
	Work closely with HODs to ensure growth and business performance, via effective implementation of HR strategy.
	Manage Training and Development intervention programmes to close competency gaps.
	Manage, supervise, and implement the performance appraisal system for the company to ensure effective performance management system.
	Drive effective communication to ensure ownership and buy-in of all change initiatives.
	Ensure adherence to HR Policies and Procedures and carry out periodic reviews.
	Manage industrial and employee relations issues.


Qualifications


	B.Sc. Degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, Psychology, or a related discipline. 
	CIPM, SHRM, or HRCI certification.


Experience:


	5–7 years of HR experience, with at least 2–3 years in a managerial or supervisory capacity.


The Person Must:


	Have a strong understanding of end-to-end recruitment, workforce planning, and talent acquisition strategies to attract and retain high-performing employees.
	Have proven ability to design, implement, and manage performance management systems that drive accountability and business results.
	Have the capacity to develop, implement, and continuously improve HR policies, procedures, and frameworks in line with labour laws and organizational objectives.
	Have strong analytical capability to interpret HR data and generate insights for management decision-making.
